css: body{font-family:'DM Serif Display','Playfair Display','Noto Serif TC','Noto Serif JP',serif}.copy{text-align:center}.badge{display:inline-block;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);opacity:.85;margin-bottom:24px}h1{font-weight:400;font-size:var(--title);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);text-shadow:0 6px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}h1 em{font-style:normal;display:inline-block;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:.6em;line-height:1.1;padding:.1em .28em;border-radius:.18em;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);vertical-align:middle;transform:translateY(-.1em)}p{font-family:'Inter','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;font-size:46px;line-height:1.4;margin:30px auto 0;max-width:960px;color:var(--ink);opacity:.9;font-weight:500}.el-stamp.pill{background:#fff;color:#111;font-family:'Inter','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
